The animals have coarse, dark greyish-brown fur, broad blunt heads, small rounded ears, and short powerful limbs with visible claws. One wombat is positioned slightly higher and to the left, while the other is lower and to the right. Both exhibit the characteristic barrel-shaped body and low center of gravity.
